steps.title: Observability Pillars
steps.text: Effective observability rests on three pillars: logs for discrete events, metrics for numeric measurements over time, and traces for tracking requests across services.

steps.title: Logging and Diagnostics
steps.text: Configure structured logging with ILogger and DiagnosticSource. Lesson 9.1 covers setting up visibility into your Surgewave application behavior.

steps.title: Metrics and Monitoring
steps.text: Expose counters, histograms, and meters for Prometheus-style monitoring using IMeterFactory. Lesson 9.2 covers the metrics pipeline.

steps.title: Common Issues
steps.text: Learn to debug consumer lag, rebalancing problems, timeouts, and memory issues. Each has distinct symptoms and requires a specific debugging approach.

steps.title: Performance Profiling
steps.text: Profile memory allocations and identify bottlenecks in your Surgewave applications. Lesson 9.5 covers profiling tools and techniques.
